in_sanskrit.name: Jhantu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Giant, Powerful
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Jhantu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Jhantu is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Jhana' meaning consciousness or knowledge. The name Jhantu is a variation of the name 'Ganesha', who is known as the elephant-headed god, symbolizing strength, wisdom, and power. In Hindu mythology, Jhantu is believed to represent the divine aspect of strength and protection.
